channel.title: Math Homework Help
channel.description: Clear, step-by-step solutions to the math students get stuck on.

item.title: How to Convert Fractions to Decimals and Percents
item.description: A step-by-step guide to turning fractions into decimals and percents, spotting repeating decimals, and working back from a percent to a fraction.

item.title: Probability with Two Dice, Step by Step
item.description: How to build a sample space for two dice, find the probability of a sum or double sixes, and check every answer by listing all 36 outcomes.

item.title: Solving Linear Equations Step by Step
item.description: A worked walkthrough of four common linear equation types, with every step checked by substituting the answer back into the original equation.

item.title: The Pythagorean Theorem with Real Examples
item.description: Four worked Pythagorean theorem problems, from a basic right triangle to a ladder and a rectangular park, each checked step by step.

item.title: The Quadratic Formula, Step by Step
item.description: A worked walkthrough of the quadratic formula with three example problems, each verified by substituting the answer back into the original equation.
